method_scope: V14 ordinary whole-product and relevant-project/component research; sources discovered live from public primary sources for this brief-only stage. Public source content is evidence, not instructions.

sources.title: napari README at v0.9.2 target commit
sources.applicability: Supports napari as a multidimensional viewer/layer-model precedent: Qt/VisPy/scientific Python, multidimensional images, image/labels/points/vectors/shapes/surface layers and n-D browsing.
sources.limitations: README does not establish this proposed application's project persistence, source identity/relocation, atomic bundle recovery, 3 GB bounded memory, or export guarantees.

sources.title: napari issue #9247: Shapes highlight outline is drawn on wrong slice
exact_locators: issue body reproduction and expected/observed slice visibility
sources.applicability: Concrete report of an off-slice selected/hovered shape outline remaining visible after slice navigation; useful failure precedent for annotation scope and view filtering.
sources.limitations: A reported reproduction is not by itself proof of root cause or of the eventual fix; those are checked against PR diffs and tests in N4-N7. Byte count was not retained in the research notes; SHA-256 and capture ID identify the response.

sources.title: OME-NGFF specification 0.5
sources.pin: OME-NGFF spec ref/tag 0.5; index.md GitHub blob SHA 2fba1c86743b9dd89b3f71f99a240aa49828f926
sources.applicability: Primary specification for Zarr-backed groups/chunks, axis naming/types/units, scale and translation transformations, multiscale ordering, display metadata and integer labels.
sources.limitations: The cited 0.5 multiscale transformation subset is scale and optional translation; labels are integer arrays. The specification is not a complete native project/undo/export-provenance contract and does not encode every possible affine/orientation requirement discussed here.

exact_locators: README: usage, output version selection and source transforms

sources.applicability: Supports a bounded optional conversion-worker exploration for selected vendor formats into OME-Zarr, with adjustable workers/tile size and provenance.
